entries.title: Proverbs 27:1
segments: ¶Boast not thyself of to morrow; for thou knowest not what a day may bring forth. {to...: Heb. to morrow day}

entries.title: Proverbs 27:2
segments: ¶Let another man praise thee, and not thine own mouth; a stranger, and not thine own lips.

words.text: thee, and not thine own mouth

entries.title: Proverbs 27:3
segments: ¶A stone [is] heavy, and the sand weighty; but a fool's wrath [is] heavier than them both. {heavy: Heb. heaviness}

entries.title: Proverbs 27:4
segments: Wrath [is] cruel, and anger [is] outrageous; but who [is] able to stand before envy? {Wrath...: Heb. Wrath is cruelty, and anger an overflowing} {envy: or, jealousy?}

words.text: ? {Wrath...: Heb. Wrath is cruelty, and anger an overflowing} {envy: or, jealousy?}

entries.title: Proverbs 27:5
segments: ¶Open rebuke [is] better than secret love.

entries.title: Proverbs 27:6
segments: Faithful [are] the wounds of a friend; but the kisses of an enemy [are] deceitful. {deceitful: or, earnest, or, frequent}

entries.title: Proverbs 27:7
segments: ¶The full soul loatheth an honeycomb; but to the hungry soul every bitter thing is sweet. {loatheth: Heb. treadeth under foot}

entries.title: Proverbs 27:8
segments: ¶As a bird that wandereth from her nest, so [is] a man that wandereth from his place.

entries.title: Proverbs 27:9
segments: ¶Ointment and perfume rejoice the heart: so [doth] the sweetness of a man's friend by hearty counsel. {by...: Heb. from the counsel of the soul}

words.text: . {by...: Heb. from the counsel of the soul}

entries.title: Proverbs 27:10
segments: Thine own friend, and thy father's friend, forsake not; neither go into thy brother's house in the day of thy calamity: [for] better [is] a neighbour [that is] near than a brother far off.

entries.title: Proverbs 27:11
segments: ¶My son, be wise, and make my heart glad, that I may answer him that reproacheth me.

entries.title: Proverbs 27:12
segments: ¶A prudent [man] foreseeth the evil, [and] hideth himself; [but] the simple pass on, [and] are punished.

entries.title: Proverbs 27:13
segments: ¶Take his garment that is surety for a stranger, and take a pledge of him for a strange woman.

words.text: of him for a strange woman

entries.title: Proverbs 27:14
segments: ¶He that blesseth his friend with a loud voice, rising early in the morning, it shall be counted a curse to him.

entries.title: Proverbs 27:15
segments: ¶A continual dropping in a very rainy day and a contentious woman are alike.

entries.title: Proverbs 27:16
segments: Whosoever hideth her hideth the wind, and the ointment of his right hand, [which] bewrayeth [itself].

entries.title: Proverbs 27:17
segments: ¶Iron sharpeneth iron; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend.

entries.title: Proverbs 27:18
segments: ¶Whoso keepeth the fig tree shall eat the fruit thereof: so he that waiteth on his master shall be honoured.

entries.title: Proverbs 27:19
segments: ¶As in water face [answereth] to face, so the heart of man to man.

entries.title: Proverbs 27:20
segments: ¶Hell and destruction are never full; so the eyes of man are never satisfied. {never: Heb. not}

entries.title: Proverbs 27:21
segments: ¶[As] the fining pot for silver, and the furnace for gold; so [is] a man to his praise.

entries.title: Proverbs 27:22
segments: ¶Though thou shouldest bray a fool in a mortar among wheat with a pestle, [yet] will not his foolishness depart from him.

entries.title: Proverbs 27:23
segments: ¶Be thou diligent to know the state of thy flocks, [and] look well to thy herds. {look...: Heb. set thy heart}

entries.title: Proverbs 27:24
segments: For riches [are] not for ever: and doth the crown [endure] to every generation? {riches: Heb. strength} {to...: Heb. to generation and generation?}

words.text: ? {riches: Heb. strength} {to...: Heb. to generation and generation?}

entries.title: Proverbs 27:25
segments: The hay appeareth, and the tender grass sheweth itself, and herbs of the mountains are gathered.

entries.title: Proverbs 27:26
segments: The lambs [are] for thy clothing, and the goats [are] the price of the field.

entries.title: Proverbs 27:27
segments: And [thou shalt have] goats' milk enough for thy food, for the food of thy household, and [for] the maintenance for thy maidens. {maintenance: Heb. life}
